meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 收到请求后，Claude 会先确定项目名（必要时询问），从 claude-mem 拉取完整时间线，估算成本并征求确认；随后派子代理按十节结构撰写“Journey Into [项目]”叙述报告（含统计与 token 回报分析），保存为 markdown 并汇报。
howto.when: 当用户请求时间线报告、项目历史分析或完整项目报告时；需 claude-mem worker 运行且该项目已有观测记录。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey Into 报告
分析当前项目的开发历史
say.note: 会以当前目录为项目名自动开始分析流程。

say.text: 生成开发时间线报告，存到 docs/journey.md
say.note: 报告完成后会保存到你指定的路径。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude determines the project name, fetches the full claude-mem timeline, estimates tokens and asks for confirmation. Then a subagent writes a ten-section 'Journey Into [Project]' narrative report (including statistics and token/memory ROI) and saves it as markdown.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, or a full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running and existing observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the full timeline and estimates token cost first.

say_en.text: Analyze the development history of the current project.
say_en.note: Uses the current directory name as the project.

say_en.text: Generate a timeline report and save it to docs/journey.md.
say_en.note: Saves the final report to your given path.
